title: Usemi Halisi na Usemi wa Taarifa (Theme 15: Maadili ya mtu binafsi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child turns direct speech into reported speech: removes the marks, adds kwamba/kuwa, changes the person, the tense and the time and place words.
representations: a change chart (mimi -> yeye, -na- -> -li-, leo -> siku hiyo)
steps: Change the tense and the time and place words.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Amina alisema kwamba alipenda kusoma pale."

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Badilisha: Juma alisema, "Mimi nitaenda." (usemi wa taarifa)" Kwa nini "Juma alisema kwamba mimi nitaenda." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Katika usemi wa taarifa mtu hubadilika: mimi huwa yeye.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni usemi upi ni wa taarifa?" Kwa nini "Juma alisema, "Nitakuja."" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Usemi wa taarifa hauna alama za usemi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Usemi halisi una nini?" Kwa nini "Maneno ya msemaji bila alama" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Usemi halisi ni maneno kamili ya msemaji katika alama za usemi.

misconceptions.ask: Siku hiyo ya "kesho" bado ni kesho kwa msomaji?
misconceptions.repair: Katika usemi wa taarifa: kesho -> siku iliyofuata, hapa -> pale.

checks.question: Badilisha: Baba alisema, "Nitarudi leo."
checks.answer: Baba alisema kwamba angerudi siku hiyo.
